description: A CLI calculator with add/sub/mul/div operations, full test coverage, and a README.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Project structure, pyproject.toml, and core arithmetic functions

tasks.description: Create project directory structure and pyproject.toml
steps: Create src/ directory
Create src/calculator/ directory
Create src/calculator/__init__.py (empty is fine)
Create tests/ directory
Create tests/__init__.py (empty is fine)
Create pyproject.toml with the structure from CLAUDE.md
Run: uv sync to install dev dependencies
tasks.verify: ls src/calculator/__init__.py tests/__init__.py pyproject.toml && python -m pytest --collect-only 2>&1 | grep 'no tests ran'

tasks.description: Implement add, subtract, multiply, divide in src/calculator/core.py
steps: Create src/calculator/core.py
Implement add(a: float, b: float) -> float
Implement subtract(a: float, b: float) -> float
Implement multiply(a: float, b: float) -> float
Implement divide(a: float, b: float) -> float — raise ZeroDivisionError if b == 0
Add type hints to all functions
Update src/calculator/__init__.py to export all four functions
tasks.verify: python -c "from src.calculator.core import add, subtract, multiply, divide; assert add(2,3)==5.0; assert subtract(5,3)==2.0; assert multiply(3,4)==12.0; assert divide(10,2)==5.0; print('core functions OK')"

phases.name: Testing
phases.description: Comprehensive pytest test suite with 100% coverage on core.py

tasks.description: Write pytest unit tests for all operations in tests/test_core.py
steps: Create tests/test_core.py
Write test_add: test positive ints, negative ints, floats, adding zero
Write test_subtract: test positive result, negative result, same numbers
Write test_multiply: test positive, negative, multiply by zero, floats
Write test_divide: test positive result, decimal result, negative dividend
Write test_divide_by_zero: assert ZeroDivisionError is raised when b=0
Ensure ALL branches in core.py are covered
tasks.verify: python -m pytest tests/test_core.py -v --tb=short && python -m pytest tests/ --cov=src/calculator/core --cov-report=term-missing 2>&1 | grep -E '(100%|PASSED)'

steps: Create src/calculator/cli.py
Import argparse and the four functions from core
Create main() function
Add positional argument: operation (choices: add, sub, mul, div)
Add two positional arguments: a and b (type=float)
Map 'add' -> add(), 'sub' -> subtract(), 'mul' -> multiply(), 'div' -> divide()
For divide: catch ZeroDivisionError, print 'Error: division by zero' to stderr, sys.exit(1)
For invalid input: argparse will handle this automatically
Output ONLY the result as a float on stdout — nothing else
Add if __name__ == '__main__': main() at the bottom
Update src/calculator/__init__.py to include cli if needed
tasks.verify: python -m calculator add 2 3 | grep -E '^5\.0$' && python -m calculator div 10 0; test $? -eq 1 && echo CLI_OK

steps: Create README.md
Add: Project title and one-line description
Add: Installation section (uv sync)
Add: CLI Usage section with examples for all four operations
Add: Library Usage section showing import and function calls
Add: Running Tests section
README must be at least 30 lines
tasks.verify: test -f README.md && wc -l README.md | awk '{print ($1 >= 30)}' | grep 1 && echo README_OK

completion.check: python -m pytest tests/ -v && python -m calculator add 2 3
